hook: Is your software finished once it launches?

slides.title: Launch is not the end
slides.body: Real businesses change, so your software needs to keep up with them.

slides.title: Support and improve
slides.body: Our process includes support after launch, so you are never left on your own.

slides.title: Talk to the builders
slides.body: Reach the people who built your software when you need a fix or a change.
